# Unit 2: Probability, Random Variables, and Probability Distributions {.unnumbered}

[← All units](../index.qmd)

::: {.chapter-lead}
**Topics 2.1–2.7.** Begin with two-way tables, relative frequencies, simulations, and exact probability models; more Unit 2 topics follow after validation.
:::

## Choose a topic

::: {.route-grid .topic-grid}
::: {.route-card}
**Topic 2.1 Tabular and Graphical Representations for the Distributions of Two Categorical Variables**

Construct a two-way table from café orders, compare count and percentage bars, read 100% segmented bars and mosaic plots, and justify an association claim.

[Open Topic 2.1 →](<Topic 2.1/topic-2-1.qmd>)
:::
::: {.route-card}
**Topic 2.2 Summary Statistics for Two Categorical Variables**

Learn joint, marginal, and conditional relative frequencies, choose the correct denominator, and interpret associations.

[Open Topic 2.2 →](<Topic 2.2/topic-2-2.qmd>)
:::
::: {.route-card}
**Topic 2.3 Estimating Probabilities Using Simulation**

Model fair random events, define a complete trial, run an interactive three-toss simulation, and interpret long-run relative frequency.

[Open Topic 2.3 →](<Topic 2.3/topic-2-3.qmd>)
:::
::: {.route-card}
**Topic 2.4 Introduction to Probability**

Calculate sample-space probabilities and complements, and explore favorable die outcomes.

[Open Topic 2.4 →](<Topic 2.4/topic-2-4.qmd>)
:::
::: {.route-card}
**Topic 2.5 Mutually Exclusive Events**

Identify outcomes in intersections, find joint probabilities, and justify whether events can occur together.

[Open Topic 2.5 →](<Topic 2.5/topic-2-5.qmd>)
:::
::: {.route-card}
**Topic 2.6 Conditional Probability**

Understand how given conditions change denominators and calculate probabilities with the general multiplication rule.

[Open Topic 2.6 →](<Topic 2.6/topic-2-6.qmd>)
:::
::: {.route-card}
**Topic 2.7 Independent Events and Unions of Events**

Compare independence with mutual exclusivity, calculate unions and complements, and explore a fair-die event model.

[Open Topic 2.7 →](<Topic 2.7/topic-2-7.qmd>)
:::
:::
